definitions.explanation: A spiral movement of water or air.
Figuratively, being caught up in something.

examples.english: I got caught in a whirlpool.
I was in the midst of war.

notes:
{渦|うず} refers to a whirlpool, vortex, or spiral — both literally (water, air) and figuratively (turmoil, chaos). It is used frequently in figurative expressions describing being caught up in events.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {渦|うず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to swirl, to form a spiral
- {渦|うず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to get caught up in (literal or figurative)
- {渦|うず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: in the midst of

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
Often paired with abstract nouns to express turmoil:
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渦|うず}: a whirl of emotions
- ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渦|うず}: a whirlpool of confusion
- ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渦|うず}: a storm of rumors

COMPOUND WORDS:
- ⟦{渦巻|うずま}き→渦巻き：27913_uzumaki⟧: spiral (shape or pattern)
- ⟦{渦潮|うずしお}→渦潮：27914_uzushio⟧: whirlpool, tidal vortex (the {鳴門|なると}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{渦潮|うずしお}→渦潮：27914_uzushio⟧ are especially famous)
